scenario: interval `overlaps` fires when ranges share points per LINT.4.1. Two overlapping ranges (0..10) and (5..15) satisfy the overlaps predicate and trigger the log action. Non-overlapping ranges would not fire.
rules_ds:
schema Range scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    start: Int mutable
    end: Int mutable

rule r:
    Range a where a.entity_id == "a"
    Range b where b.entity_id == "b" and (a.start..a.end) overlaps (b.start..b.end)
->
    log critical "overlap"
